mapper.sql: sm.seat_map_id AS seatMapId, sm.cinema_id AS cinemaId, sm.rows_n AS rowsN, sm.cols_n AS colsN, sm.screen_label AS screenLabel, sm.mutable, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM seat s WHERE s.seat_map_id = sm.seat_map_id) AS seatCount
mapper.select: SELECT FROM seat_map sm WHERE sm.seat_map_id = #{seatMapId}
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM seat_map WHERE cinema_id = #{cinemaId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO seat_map (seat_map_id, cinema_id, rows_n, cols_n, screen_label, mutable) VALUES (#{seatMapId}, #{cinemaId}, #{rowsN}, #{colsN}, #{screenLabel}, #{mutable})
mapper.update: UPDATE seat_map SET mutable = FALSE WHERE seat_map_id = #{seatMapId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM seat_map WHERE seat_map_id = #{seatMapId} AND mutable = TRUE
